Total Family Solutions will soon offer comprehensive Medication Management services at our Ocala office and via secure telehealth. This service is designed to support children, adolescents, adults, couples, and families who may benefit from professional evaluation, monitoring, and guidance regarding mental health medications.

Our licensed providers work closely with each client to create safe, effective, and individualized treatment plans that complement ongoing therapy. Medication Management focuses on helping clients achieve optimal mental health outcomes, reduce symptoms, improve overall well-being, and maintain stability in daily life. By integrating medication support with strength-based, solution-focused therapy, we provide a holistic, personalized approach that addresses both the emotional and clinical aspects of mental health care. Our goal is to empower clients to develop healthy coping skills, strengthen personal and family relationships, and build long-term resilience for lasting emotional and behavioral growth.

The results guide personalized treatment recommendations, ensuring that every patient receives the most effective and supportive care possible.
